run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 core government portals covered broadly via WebSearch (AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA/SA/TAS, NT QTOL, ACT) plus a rotating council sample (Gold Coast, City of Sydney, City of Perth) via VendorPanel/TenderLink. Tier 2 GBE/university/health (SA Water, Ausgrid, CSIRO, University of Sydney, Port of Melbourne, Western Sydney International Airport) and Tier 3 corporate channels (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/ICN Gateway, Qantas, Coles, Woolworths, EnergyAustralia) checked, with corporate opportunities recorded as portals where login-gated. NOTE: WebFetch and direct HTTP were egress-blocked (403) this run, so all data was extracted from WebSearch result titles/URLs/snippets only and no tender detail page could be opened for full deliverables/requirements extraction.
gaps: WebFetch and direct HTTP were egress-blocked (403 from the network egress proxy) for ALL external domains this run (including tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au and even wikipedia.org). Only the WebSearch tool was usable. Consequently every tender is headline-level: deliverables_summary, requirements, evaluation_criteria, values, documents, contacts and exact closing times could not be read from detail pages. All entries are counted in entries_pending_detail and need an authenticated/API follow-up pass.

Freshness could not be fully verified: WebSearch snippets rarely include publish dates, so most items were confirmed as currently open/recent by close-date context rather than a datestamped publish date within 2026-08-02..2026-08-09.

Several state-portal listings (Tenders WA, Buying4SA, Brisbane City Council SAP Ariba, City of Melbourne) were JS- or login-gated in snippets; portals recorded but individual current opportunities not extractable.
Some snippet-reported dates fell AFTER today's date (Tas Stormwater 18 Aug, Tas DAC Track 21 Aug, NT PM044 open 16 Aug) and appeared unreliable; those dates were omitted/nulled rather than trusted.

Tier 3 corporate procurement is overwhelmingly login- or invitation-gated (Coles/Ariba, Woolworths Partner Hub, Qantas/Coupa, NAB/CBA/Westpac/ANZ Ariba, EnergyAustralia/AGL/Origin). Recorded as portals in discovered_sources only; no public corporate RFx was fabricated. Management-consultancy RFPs (Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte-type) remain invitation-only and out of scope.
SAP Ariba Discovery current Australian open postings could not be enumerated via WebSearch (not publicly listable without a supplier login).
Construction subcontractor packages (EstimateOne, iTWOcx, BidContender) require a free account to view builder-uploaded packages; platforms recorded, no specific live package captured.

The paid aggregator australiantenders.com.au appeared in results and was used ONLY as a discovery signal; the affected opportunities (SA Water Millicent EOI, Ausgrid BESS Panel, University of Sydney Campus Master Plan) were re-attributed to the buyer's own portal as the source of truth, and aggregator-only items that could not be tied to a buyer channel or appeared stale were dropped.

Dropped as clearly closed/stale during consolidation: Melbourne Water Cardinia Dam RFP (closed 27 Mar 2026), CSIRO Cafe Operators EOI (~Jun 2026), University of Sydney Environmental & Sustainability Panel EOI (2025). Thin headline-only AusTender duplicates already well-covered in prior runs (RFT-2026-0080, ATM_2026_6489) were also omitted.

Port of Melbourne eProcurement (portofmelbourne.com/tenders) - GBE with a public current-tenders list.

eTender Queensland HPW (etender.hpw.qld.gov.au) - confirm whether distinct from QTenders.
EnergyAustralia SAP Ariba supplier portal (record as login-gated corporate portal).
